verses.text: So I made up my mind that I would not make another painful visit to you.
If I make you sad, who will make me glad? Only you, the ones I made sad.
I wrote to you as I did so that when I came, I would not be made sad by the very people who should make me happy. I was sure that all of you would share my joy.
I wrote to you with a very troubled and aching heart, and with many tears. I did not want to make you sad, but to let you know how deeply I love you.
If anyone has caused sadness, he has not so much made me sad as all of you, at least in part. I do not want to say it too strongly.
The punishment that most of you gave this man is enough for him.
So now you should forgive him and comfort him instead. If you do not, he may be crushed by too much sadness.
So I beg you to show him again that you love him.
I wrote to you to test you, to see if you would obey in everything.
Anyone you forgive, I forgive too. And what I have forgiven, if there was anything to forgive, I have forgiven for your sake in front of Christ.
We do this so that Satan will not get the better of us. We know his tricks very well.
When I came to Troas to preach the good news of Christ, the Lord opened a door for me.
But I still had no peace of mind, because I did not find my brother Titus there. So I said goodbye to the people there and went on to Macedonia.
But thanks be to God, who always leads us like a winning army in Christ. Through us he spreads the knowledge of Christ everywhere, like a sweet smell.
To God we are the sweet smell of Christ among those who are being saved and among those who are dying.
To those who are dying, we are a smell of death that brings death. To those who are being saved, we are a smell of life that brings life. And who is able for such a task?
We are not like so many people who sell God's message to make money. No, we speak honestly in Christ, as people sent from God, standing in front of God.
